title: VA Home Loan Guaranty Restoration of Entitlement on a Liquidated Loan at the Veteran's Request
content:
Under the VA Home Loan Guaranty, entitlement tied up in a loan that was liquidated by foreclosure, compromise sale or deed in lieu, with a guaranty claim paid, is restored when the veteran asks for it. The veteran files the request personally, and the restoration takes effect on the spot for the amount of entitlement the representative has told the veteran can be restored on that liquidated loan.

## When the figure is fixed

The entitlement restored on a liquidated loan is fixed only after the loan's money transactions carry a refund entry for every funding fee charge on a loan the record shows exempt from the funding fee.

Put another way: on a liquidated loan whose record shows the veteran exempt from the funding fee, the amount restored is not fixed while any funding fee charge among the loan's money transactions is without a refund entry; on such a loan, it is fixed once every funding fee charge has one.

## What the restoration does

The request adds one restoration entry to the loan's entitlement history, dated today, on the ground that the loan ended in a guaranty claim. The entitlement tied up in that loan is reduced by the amount restored, which becomes available for a future VA loan.

## Invocation

The request is made with the veteran's own tool `apply_entitlement_restoration_1db0e5c4`. The representative unlocks it for the veteran (`unlock_user_discoverable_tool`) and hands it over; the customer themselves, the veteran, personally certifies and submits the request by running it.

### Parameters

| Parameter | Meaning | Format |
|---|---|---|
| `loan_id` | The reference number of the liquidated VA home loan record whose entitlement is being restored, as given to the veteran by the representative from the loan lookup | Identifier |
| `entitlement_amount` | The amount of entitlement restored | USD, a positive number with 2 decimal places, rounded half up to the cent before it is passed |

### Return

On success the veteran receives a receipt with `entitlement_action_id` (the reference number of the new restoration entry), `loan_id` (the loan whose entitlement was restored), `entitlement_amount` (USD, 2 decimal places, the amount restored), `action_date` (today's date, YYYY-MM-DD) and `status`, which is always `entitlement_restored` when the entry was written. No other outcome is defined.

## Illustration (hypothetical values)

A veteran who runs the tool with the reference of the liquidated loan and `entitlement_amount` 41,499.60 receives a receipt with `status` `entitlement_restored`, `entitlement_amount` 41,499.60 and today's `action_date`; the loan's entitlement history then shows that restoration entry.
